outcomes.question: 2Q Spread: Eagles (-2.5)

raw_market.question: 2Q Spread: Eagles (-2.5)
raw_market.description:
In the second quarter of the NFL game between Eagles and Jaguars, scheduled for October 11 at 9:30 AM ET:

This market will resolve to "Eagles" if the Eagles outscore the Jaguars by 3 or more points in the second quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Jaguars".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
